Both premises are analyst statements with attribution deferred; neither is the selected-time Aquinas statement 8b2561cd. Given #1856's equivalence (under 0e473dc4 and d3184c66 the nonexternal premise 2a4d99d8 is equivalent to e4a3b917), this support does not discriminate against a rival who denies that a necessary concretum is possible. No premise is established.
